name: play-video-v1
comment: Agent Visibility Phase 2, Slice J1-Video. A TEST fixture, not a real-bug seed (tests/lanista-seeds/README.md admission rule) — no diagnosed bug behind it, so it stays out of tests/lanista-seeds/. Seeds VaultRecent's file-backed open-recent.json with one 'video' entry so a Lanista session can drive the SAME assembled-app entry point a user uses (taskbar Open Media -> Recent -> one-click reopen, execution plan Slice 9) into a real decoded-frame player, instead of clicking the native OS file picker Lanista cannot see (vault_launch_smoke.json's own documented limit). `--seed <this dir>` (absolute path) copies vault/open-recent.json into the tagged session's AppData root pre-launch (commit 4ebec25 fix — reaches Roaming stores directly).

mediaFixture.videoProvenance: the SAME fixture tests/auto/player/tst_journey_play_video.cpp's decoded_fixture_reports_exact_dimensions case and vault_admission_probe_harness both use — a real ffmpeg-generated MP4 whose avc1 stsd box stores 64x64, confirmed decodable (MediaAdmissionProbe::Verdict::Admitted).
mediaFixture.audioOnlyProvenance: the SAME audio-only fixture tst_journey_play_video.cpp's audio_only_never_ready case uses — reaches mpv fileLoaded/endFile but never a decoded video frame (MediaAdmissionProbe::Verdict::RejectedNoVideo). Its extension (.m4a) is also outside VaultKit's kVideoExts, so LocalLaunch::classify() alone already returns Family::Unknown for it — see journey_play_video.json's negative-control comment for what this means for where the red actually surfaces.
